maintenance.reviewPolicy: Human review required for every structural or archival change
maintenance.periodHint: Aggregate reservations prevent overlapping runs from exceeding the monthly allowance. Unspent model capacity is released after a known no-call outcome; interrupted or unknown usage stays conservative. Work crossing a month boundary must reserve the new month too.
maintenance.costHint: A strict monetary cap defers model analysis when an execution cost bound is unavailable, including OAuth models. Leave it empty to use call and token limits; unknown cost is never displayed as zero.
maintenance.empty: No recurring routines. Add a scoped routine to preview its calendar and limits before enabling it.
maintenance.diagnosticHint: Signals identify review candidates, not proven semantic defects. Citation review alone does not mean the text changed. Isolated or old material may be valuable.
maintenance.linksPreserved: Stable page links, original citations, aliases and revision history are preserved. Only the shown navigation placement changes; no vault file is deleted.

errors.scope: Select a valid scope and domain.
errors.budget: The configured run budget is invalid or exhausted.
errors.period: The UTC calendar-month allowance is reserved or exhausted. Due work remains deferred.
errors.conflict: The page, schedule or active instructions changed. Review a fresh run.
errors.revoked: This routine or run was paused, changed or canceled.
errors.wait: Compatible work is already running. This occurrence remains deferred.
errors.busy: Waiting for imports or foreground work to finish.
errors.sync: Waiting for pending or conflicting synchronized edits.
errors.retry: This result needs a new run; retry cannot reset its allowance or authority.
errors.failed: Maintenance failed. The persisted inspection and usage remain available.
errors.invalid: The model proposed an invalid or unauthorized change. Nothing was applied.
errors.protected: A protected placement or ineligible draft cannot be changed by maintenance.
errors.cycle: The proposed tree would contain a cycle.
errors.calendar: The calendar or timezone is invalid.
errors.model: Select an eligible model profile or disable model analysis.
errors.costUnknown: Model analysis deferred: no reliable execution cost bound is available for the strict monetary cap.
errors.context: The bounded candidate context does not fit this model. Use a smaller scope or a larger context profile.
errors.inspectionBudget: Inspection allowance reached; the saved cursor continues in a later run.
errors.uncertain: An interrupted model call has uncertain usage. Its reservation is retained and it is not replayed automatically.
errors.idle: Waiting for the configured idle window.

maintenance.restored: Page restored as a new revision. The archive history is preserved.

obsidianWiki.title: Wiki projection
obsidianWiki.readOnly: A compatible plugin with editorial permission saves title and section edits to Memora. Without it, edits stay local. Generated navigation, evidence and relations are read only.
obsidianWiki.recover: Preserve local copy and use application version
obsidianWiki.recoveryHint: Recovery keeps your vault version in .memora-recovery and projection history before writing the application version. Wiki edits are not imported.
obsidianWiki.queued: Projection updates run through the job queue.

errors.conflict: The vault file changed. Review the local edits before projecting again.
errors.binding: The vault or projection scope changed. Start synchronization again.
errors.paused: Obsidian synchronization is paused or unavailable.
errors.limit: This projection exceeds its size limit. Select a smaller scope.
errors.format: A managed projection has invalid or unsupported content markers.
errors.write: The vault write failed. Your previous content remains recoverable.

obsidianWiki.finishDraft: Finish or cancel your draft to open the incoming Obsidian link.

obsidianEditing.deliveryError: Delivery failed. Check pairing, desktop availability and local disk space, then retry.
obsidianEditing.stale: The file or application changed again. Refresh the comparison before resolving.
obsidianEditing.scopeHint: The paired plugin can save source, note and wiki prose revisions. Generated evidence and relations stay read only. Saving does not process AI.
obsidianEditing.rePair: Pairing revoked or missing write permission. Create a new Obsidian pairing in Memora and reconnect.
obsidianEditing.unsupported: Unsupported sync version. Update Memora and the plugin.
obsidianEditing.diskError: Local queue could not be saved. Free disk space before retrying.
obsidianEditing.detachHint: Keep this file as an unmanaged local copy. The original remains linked to Memora.

variables.question: Admitted question
variables.group_id: Coherent proposal identity supplied by the backend.
variables.reference_guide: Typed navigation handles for existing sources, notes, pages and entities. Original eN handles are citation-only.
variables.required_notes: Selected existing note handles that must appear in an index without copying their content.
variables.candidate_knowledge: Complete proposed group, including titles, purposes, prose and TOC attribution, checked against original evidence.

purposes.shared: Reusable wording composed into the affected model requests.
purposes.summary: Summarizes original material while preserving evidence and uncertainty.
purposes.notes: Extracts source ideas or evaluates their meaningful connections.
purposes.graph: Extracts or validates grounded entities and directed relations.
purposes.sources: Checks original passages before proposing connections between works.
purposes.embedding: Formats vector inputs. Changes require explicit re-embedding of incompatible content.
purposes.organization: Guides the bounded evidence-reading and page-proposal workflow.
purposes.consultation: Answers a question using only the admitted scope and original citations.
purposes.maintenance: Reviews bounded navigation changes for the selected routine.
purposes.diagnostics: Runs only when an explicit model diagnostic is requested.

prompts.title: Prompts
prompts.description: Edit the instructions used by the application. Changes affect future work; saving never reprocesses your library.
prompts.syntax: Use %variable_name% once. %% writes a literal percent; ordinary percentages such as 50% remain text. Source text is never reinterpreted as a template.
prompts.moved: Instructions and their history are now managed in Prompts.

errors.invalid: The prompt could not be validated.
errors.conflict: The active revision changed. Reload before activating.
errors.sample: Run the required samples for this exact composition before activation.
errors.model: No compatible model is configured. Your draft is saved.
errors.scope: This prompt does not support the selected scope.
errors.moved: Instructions and their history are now managed in Prompts.
errors.type_mismatch: The variable has the wrong type.
errors.missing_contract: A required contract token is missing.
errors.composition_cycle: Shared fragments contain a dependency cycle.
errors.partial: This batch is complete. Run another sample batch to continue the saved validation.
errors.budget: The cumulative sample allowance is exhausted. The draft and completed checks remain saved.

prompts.sampleBounds: Each sample batch runs at most 12 calls, with up to 4,096 output tokens per call. A composition has a cumulative ceiling of 256 calls, 2,000,000 input characters and 1,048,576 reserved output tokens. Completed cases are reused when you continue.
prompts.partial: This batch is complete. Run another sample batch to continue the saved validation.

automaticWiki.scopeHint: Select a small set of original sources. Check the execution limits in the policy preview.
automaticWiki.title: Organize automatically
automaticWiki.intro: Select material and preview its scoped policy. The model discovers useful topics and reading indexes from original evidence.
automaticWiki.originals: With no notes selected, curation uses originals only. This action does not generate notes, summaries, vectors, matching or graphs.
automaticWiki.limits: Up to {targets} pages or indexes, {sections} section patches per page, {passages} complete passages, {calls} model admissions and {minutes} minutes including queue waits.
automaticWiki.permission: Creates grounded drafts and reading indexes, updates unprotected AI content and gives new pages their initial placement. Human text and fixed ordering require review. Activation installs the disclosed recurring routines together; they run when their schedule and eligibility conditions allow. You can also integrate selected materials manually.
automaticWiki.assessment: AI draft — original references checked structurally; semantic support has not been verified by a person.
automaticWiki.modelAssessment: AI draft — original references and semantic support checked by the selected model; still unreviewed by a person.
automaticWiki.readOnlyAssessment: Read-only assessment. Existing artifacts are reused; no optional processing is started.
automaticWiki.excludedHint: Exclude these sources and all their descendants from this policy.
automaticWiki.previewChanges: Preview and activate these changes before starting new work. The current policy remains in effect.

automaticMaintenance.title: Automatic content maintenance
automaticMaintenance.disclosure: Runs while the desktop is open, normally after one minute idle. Run now bypasses only idle. Groups share the policy’s monthly allowance. Unknown cost is unavailable.
automaticMaintenance.allowance: Up to {calls} calls / {tokens} reserved tokens / {minutes} active minutes
automaticMaintenance.monthlyAllowance: Shared UTC calendar month: {calls} calls / {tokens} reserved tokens
automaticMaintenance.calibration: Preset luna-a2-a3-conservative-v1 uses the accepted synthetic Luna trials plus repair margin. Reservations use conservative input bytes and bounded output; these small trials do not guarantee cost or latency.
automaticMaintenance.notInstalled: This existing policy has no automatic routines. Preview and activate it to review setup.
automaticMaintenance.startWindow: Target start within {minutes} eligible open minutes
automaticMaintenance.clock: Eligible {eligible} min · start window remaining {remaining} min · active {active} min · deferred {deferred} min · closed/unknown {closed} min
automaticMaintenance.groupLimit: Groups up to {minutes} minutes including FIFO
